channel.title: Astrology guides | RasiVani
channel.description: Simple, practical guides to jathagam, porutham, panchangam and daily rasi palan, written for Indian families.

item.title: The Ikigai Chart Isn't Japanese: Ikigai vs the Gita's Swadharma
item.description: World Wisdom day: what does Japan's ikigai really mean, and why is the famous four-circle chart not Japanese at all? How the Bhagavad Gita's idea of swadharma completes it. Plus Okinawa's hara hachi bu, the art of kintsugi, and the planet whose day is longer than its year.

item.title: The Festival That Prays to the SETTING Sun: Chhath and the World's Sun Secrets
item.description: Chhath Puja begins today: millions stand in rivers to honour the setting and the rising Sun. Plus Konark's Sun chariot, the Egyptian temple the Sun enters twice a year, Japan's Sun goddess, Peru's Inti Raymi, and India's Pongal. One Sun, one gratitude, across the world.

item.title: Ekadashi, Pradosham, Amavasya and Pournami: Monthly Vrat Days
item.description: The main monthly fasting and prayer days in Hindu tradition, how they come from the tithi, and what families do on each.

item.title: Binary Code 2,000 Years Before Computers? Zero and Pingala's Secret
item.description: Computers run on 0 and 1. More than 2,000 years ago, the Indian scholar Pingala counted the short and long syllables of poetry in the same way. Brahmagupta's rules for zero, the dot-zero of the Bakhshali manuscript, the Gwalior temple inscription, and the 'Fibonacci' numbers an Indian poet found centuries earlier.

item.title: Panchangam Basics: Tithi, Vara, Nakshatra, Yoga and Karana
item.description: What the five parts of the panchangam mean, how they are calculated from the Sun and Moon, and how families use the daily panchangam.

item.title: The 4:30 AM Secret Hour: Brahma Muhurta, Explained with Science
item.description: What is Brahma Muhurta, and exactly when is it? The ancient 48-minute muhurta, what the Ayurveda text Ashtanga Hridayam says, what modern sleep science agrees with and warns about, and 4 simple things to do before sunrise.

item.title: Vimshottari Dasha and Bhukti: Your Planetary Periods Explained
item.description: How Vimshottari dasha works: the 120-year cycle, mahadasha lengths for each planet, bhukti (antardasha) and how to find your current period.

item.title: Why Does Murugan Have 6 Faces? The Six Secrets of Kanda Sashti
item.description: Kanda Sashti begins today. Why does Lord Murugan have six faces? Six sparks, the six Krittika mothers of the Pleiades, the six abodes of Tamil Nadu, the demon who became a peacock and a rooster, Murugan from Kataragama to Malaysia's Batu Caves, and how the six-day fast is kept.

item.title: 27 Nakshatras: Find Your Birth Star and What It Means
item.description: A simple guide to the 27 nakshatras (birth stars), their padas, ruling planets and how your birth star is used in naming, porutham and dasha.

item.title: How a Palm Leaf Kept Knowledge Alive for 1,000 Years: India's Manuscript Secret
item.description: Before paper, India wrote medicine, maths and astronomy on palm leaves. How was a palm-leaf book made, with an iron stylus, soot and oil? How were insects kept away? Why recopying was the real secret, the scholars who saved Sangam poetry and Vemana's verses, and the Gyan Bharatam mission that has reported more than 1.2 crore manuscripts.

item.title: Sade Sati (Ezharai Sani): Meaning, Phases and Simple Remedies
item.description: Sade Sati explained: the 7½-year Saturn transit, its three phases, Ashtama and Ardhashtama Shani, which rasis have it now, and calm practical remedies.

item.title: Why Oil Bath Before Sunrise on Deepavali? The Secret of Lamps on the Darkest Night
item.description: Why do millions of Indians take an oil bath before sunrise on Deepavali, and ask "Ganga snanam aacha?" Why are lamps lit on Amavasya, the darkest night of the month? The story of Narakasura, the Ayurveda reason behind the oil bath, how North India, Bengal, Gujarat, Jains and Sikhs celebrate, and the truth about the viral "NASA Diwali photo".

item.title: Rajju and Vedha Porutham: Why They Matter Most
item.description: What Rajju dosham and Vedha dosham mean in marriage matching, which stars fall in each rajju, and why families treat these two poruthams as essential.

item.title: Rahu Kalam, Yamagandam and Gulikai: How They Are Calculated
item.description: Why Rahu kalam changes every day and city, how it is worked out from sunrise and sunset, and what people avoid during Rahu kalam, Yamagandam and Gulikai.

item.title: Your Month Is Named After a Star: The 27 Nakshatras of Ancient India
item.description: Chaitra, Vaishakha, Kartika, Margashira... where do India's month names come from? The Moon's 27-star path, the full moon, the Pleiades, Karthigai Deepam and the number 108, in one short story.

item.title: How to Read Your Jathagam (Birth Chart): A Beginner’s Guide
item.description: Understand your jathagam step by step: lagna, rasi, nakshatra, the 12 houses, navamsa chart and dasha, with a free online jathagam in 10 languages.

item.title: 10 Poruthams for Marriage Explained (Thirumana Porutham)
item.description: All 10 marriage poruthams in plain words: Dina, Gana, Mahendra, Stree Deergha, Yoni, Rasi, Rasi Adhipati, Vasya, Rajju and Vedha, and how the score works.

item.title: What is Chandrashtamam? Meaning, days and what to avoid
item.description: Chandrashtamam explained simply: why the Moon in the 8th house from your rasi matters, how often it comes and what to avoid on those days.
